fields.label: Narrative (mouse over for directions)
fields.value: The risk is a four-story, 6,915-square-foot joisted masonry (ISO 2) mixed-use building with four apartments and one ground-floor commercial tenant. The building was constructed in 1910 and renovated in 2010. The exterior walls are solid brick masonry, the roof is heavy timber framing with rolled asphalt roofing. Housekeeping is good throughout. The utilities appeared to be in good working condition and arranged in accordance with current code requirements. The building is 100% occupied. There were no reported losses.
